title: Houska's 25-point, 14-rebound, 11-assist triple-double drives Valecnici Decin to U19 Boys title on home court
description: Valecnici Decin claimed the 2025-26 Czech Extraliga U19 Boys championship in front of a packed home crowd of 980, riding Marek Houska (194-PG-2009)'s sensational triple-double to an 88-79 victory over BK Sojky Pelhrimov at ARMEX Sportcentrum on Sunday. Houska was untouchable 25 points on 10-of-15 shooting (8-of-9 from two), 14 rebounds (11 defensive), and a game-high 11 assists in 36 minutes for a staggering 40 efficiency rating. The hometown star orchestrated Decin's offense with precision while dominating the glass, delivering the kind of complete performance that championship games are built on.
imageCaption: Valecnici Decin wins U19 Boys title on home court (Photo: instagram)

title: GBA Lions cruise past USK Praha to claim U19 title
description: FINALGBA Lions - USK Praha 87-64 It looked good early as USK Praha took a 1-point small lead at the end of first quarter. But then Hradec had a 19-11 second period charge getting the lead and USK Praha was not able to take back game control losing it eventually 64-87. Strangely USK Praha outrebounded GBA Lions 52-40 including 19 on the offensive glass. Their players were unselfish on offense dishing 21 assists. USK Praha was plagued by 24 personal fouls down the stretch. Swingman Marek Zvolanek (201-2006) stepped up and scored 17 points and 9 rebounds for the winners and Lithuanian Kristijonas Strackaitis (-2007) chipped in 22 points. Hradec's coach Ben Wisniewski felt very confident that he used entire bench which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games. At the losing side forward Samuel Macht (203-2006) responded with a double-double by scoring 11 points and 17 rebounds…
imageCaption: GBA Lions cruise past USK Praha to claim U19 title (Photo: bkjh.esports.cz)

title: U19 League Round 1 of Finals. USK Praha crowned champions
description: The game was mostly controlled by USK Praha. Tygri Praha was better in third quarter 15-14. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Tygri Praha was plagued by 25 personal fouls down the stretch. Swingman Mikulas Kramosil (193-2005) nailed 31 points, 9 rebounds and 6 assists for the winning side and guard Matyas Jezek (192-2005) accounted for 25 points, 12 rebounds and 5 assists. Forward Jan Matusik (201-2006) came up with 17 points and 9 rebounds and Karel Belohradsky (-2005) added 13 points and 7 rebounds respectively for Tygri Praha in the defeat. Tygri Praha's coach gave up on the game allowing to play twelve players seeing no chance for a win.

title: U19 League Round 1 of Finals. Basket Brno top GBA Lions to win the title
description: FINALGBA Lions - Basket Brno 73-87 Basket Brno dominated down low during the game scoring 64 of its points in the paint compared to Hradec's 44. Forward Milan Stranel (201-2005) stepped up with a double-double by scoring 20 points and 13 rebounds for the winners and forward Simon Svoboda (202-2004) chipped in 23 points and 5 rebounds (on 10-of-12 shooting from the field). Four Basket Brno players scored in double figures. At the losing side Lithuanian Rokas Jocys (195-2004) responded with 38 points (!!!) and 8 rebounds and Swedish guard Viktor Lukic-Gavric (188-2005) scored 8 points and 6 rebounds. Hradec's coach rotated eleven players which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
imageCaption: Basket Brno top GBA Lions to win the title (Photo: Basket Brno)
